Who We Are

Inspired by the Gut. Driven by the Quest to Heal.

The name ENTERA draws inspiration from the Latin-rooted word Entero, reflecting the world of the digestive system.

We believe that a healthy digestive system is fundamental to nutritional absorption, metabolic balance and overall vitality: the foundations of a healthier life. This belief defines our purpose and shapes our commitment to three interconnected domains.

  • Scientific Thinking
  • Pioneering Technologies
  • Clinical Insights
  • Passion for Innovation

At ENTERA THERAPEUTICS, we bring together scientific thinking, pioneering technologies, clinical insights and a passion for innovation to address evolving healthcare needs. We are a science-driven organisation aspiring to move beyond conventional approaches, explore emerging therapeutic possibilities and create meaningful solutions for unmet clinical needs.

Our access to a network of thought leaders, clinicians and clinical researchers enables us to gain deeper therapeutic insights, challenge conventional thinking and anticipate the future direction of patient care. We aspire to be recognised as trendsetters, bringing forward-thinking, dependable and scientifically grounded healthcare solutions to evolving areas of clinical practice.

Our belief

Every life we touch deserves the opportunity to heal, thrive and live better.

What We Do

Advancing Science. Transforming Therapeutic Possibilities.

Our work is driven by the pursuit of meaningful innovation in Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Clinical Nutrition. We leverage pioneering technologies in product development, scientific collaborations and emerging clinical evidence to develop differentiated healthcare solutions.

Our approach extends beyond conventional product development. We seek to identify evolving therapeutic needs, understand disease complexity and translate scientific advancements into dependable solutions that can make a meaningful difference in patient management.

01

Pioneering Product Development

Leveraging advanced technologies, scientific research and differentiated formulation strategies to develop innovative products for evolving clinical needs, with a focus on safety, scientific credibility, product differentiation and meaningful clinical relevance.

02

Gut Microbiome & Personalised Nutrition

Exploring emerging opportunities in signature gut microbiome profiling and personalised nutritional care, particularly in chronic disease management, opening new possibilities for more personalised approaches to patient care.

03

Postbiotics: The Next Frontier in Gut Health

We aspire to introduce postbiotic-based innovations into gastrointestinal therapeutics, an exciting emerging area for exploration, with the ambition of differentiated solutions that may contribute to better daily living, including for people living with obesity and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

04

Clinical Intelligence & Scientific Collaborations

Our network of thought leaders, clinical researchers and healthcare professionals helps us identify unmet needs, interpret emerging evidence and explore future therapeutic opportunities through scientific dialogue and evidence-led innovation.

05

Empowering Better Patient Outcomes

Our ultimate focus is the patient. Through differentiated products, emerging therapeutic technologies and personalised approaches to nutritional care, we aspire to contribute to safer, more effective and more meaningful patient management.

We don’t simply follow therapeutic trends. We aspire to help shape what comes next.

Overview

Gastroenterology at ENTERA

Gastroenterology is at the heart of ENTERA. Our name draws inspiration from Entero, the world of the digestive system, and our work begins with the gut.

We focus on understanding disease complexity in the digestive tract and translating scientific advancements into dependable solutions that can make a meaningful difference in patient management.

  • Gut health and the microbiome
  • Chronic gastrointestinal conditions

Areas of Focus

Digestive Health & Function

Supporting healthy digestion as the foundation for nutritional absorption and overall vitality.

Gut Microbiome Science

Understanding the role of gut microbial signatures in health and in chronic disease.

Chronic GI Conditions

Addressing unmet needs in long-term conditions such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

Patient Quality of Life

Looking beyond symptoms towards better daily living for people with digestive conditions.

Emerging innovation

Postbiotics: The Next Frontier in Gut Health

We aspire to introduce postbiotic-based innovations into gastrointestinal therapeutics. With growing scientific interest in the gut microbiome and its metabolic interactions, postbiotics represent an exciting emerging area for therapeutic exploration.

Our ambition is to develop differentiated solutions that may contribute to better daily living and improved quality of life for patients, including those living with obesity and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).
